_readme: The price book. Every number here was taken from the vendor's own published rate,
with the source recorded on each row. Nothing is estimated.
A null price is left null on purpose — it means the number depends on YOUR invoice
(hosting, database) and nobody outside your account can look it up. A null entry is
not an error: the ledger still records that usage at $0 and logs a warning naming the
sku, so volume is never lost while a price is missing. Margins understate rather than
lie. Fill it in and re-run `pnpm --filter @acme/api cost:seed`.
microUsdPerUnit is USD * 1,000,000 for `unitSize` base units.
$0.006 per minute of audio ->  microUsdPerUnit 6000,    unitSize 60 (seconds)
(storage is metered in micro-GB-months, hence the 1000000 unitSize)
To change a price, edit the value and set a NEW effectiveFrom. Never rewrite history:
corrections are inserts, so a vendor price rise cannot silently restate last quarter.
Re-check these when a vendor announces a change. One is already scheduled: Meta moves
Bangladesh onto a standalone WhatsApp rate card on 2026-10-01.

rates.source: $4.50/1M — openai.com/api/pricing + openrouter.ai (checked 2026-09-06). 6x input, which is why output tokens dominate the bill
$0.006/minute, billed to the nearest second — openai.com/api/pricing (checked 2026-09-06)
$0.025/GB-mo, first 50TB, ap-southeast-1 — AWS Price List API, AmazonS3/current/ap-southeast-1 (checked 2026-09-06)
$0.12/GB, first 10TB out to internet from ap-southeast-1 — AWS Price List API, AWSDataTransfer (checked 2026-09-06). Not yet instrumented; see note below
$0.0001/recipient = $0.10 per 1,000 — AWS Price List API, AmazonSES ap-southeast-1, usagetype APS1-Recipients (checked 2026-09-06)

2.5% on Visa/Mastercard — sslcommerz.com/pricing (checked 2026-09-06). Only a fallback: markInvoicePaid prefers the exact fee derived from store_amount. Replace if your merchant agreement was negotiated

$0 — service conversations have been free since 2024-11-01, and every reply the agent sends is a service message inside the 24h customer window (developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing, checked 2026-09-06). Only TEMPLATE messages are billed, which this codebase does not send today. NOTE: Bangladesh moves to a standalone rate card on 2026-10-01 — re-check then, and price templates separately if abandoned-cart follow-ups ever go out beyond 24h
NVIDIA NIM free tier — priced at zero deliberately, so the volume is still tracked and the day it stops being free is visible
YOUR Coolify VPS invoice — nobody outside your account can look this up. Fixed monthly, allocated across stores at read time

YOUR Neon bill. Neon is usage-based, not a flat plan fee (Launch: $0.106/CU-hour compute + $0.35/GB-month storage; Scale: $0.222/CU-hour) — neon.com/pricing (checked 2026-09-06). Take last month's invoice total
YOUR Redis bill. Set to 0 if self-hosted on the same VPS as `hosting`, to avoid double-counting the same machine
